item.title: Pull request #2978 created
item.description:
2972 Records and simplicity

…an attempt to simplify records, as motivated by the table in https://github.com/qt4cg/qtspecs/issues/2972#issuecomment-6096543708. All kind of feedback is welcome (much more time went into this than originally planned; it also includes cleanups of minor inconsistencies).

The good thing: it made the implementation much easier again.

Closes #2972
